content: Letter to Ibn Turka from Qāżīzāda Rūmī, on receiving a copy of Ibn Turka's Sharḥ al-Basmala (ca. 829/1426, Samarkand): the astronomer opens with great respect, praising Ibn Turka's mastery of the whole Islamic tradition and spiritual perfection, and expresses a great desire to see him in person. MK's footnote: the treatise was completed by 829/1426, so the letter was written around the time of letters 24 and 25 above (MS Majlis 10196 f. 153b).
refers_to_primary: Letter of Qāżīzāda Rūmī, MS Majlis 10196 f. 153b
